title: GameSaveVault save rules
description: Portable description of where a game keeps its saves. Used by scan, backup, discover and restore.

name.description: Display name. Also used as the default install folder name.

aliases.description: Alternative names used when matching a detected game.

steamAppIds.description: Steam / scene AppIDs that identify this game.

installDirNames.description: Folder names used to find the game on a new machine (Steam library, D:\Games, repack folder, ...).

folderPatterns.description: Save folder globs used by discovery, e.g. *save*, SaveGames.

discover.description: When no path exists, search the game install for save-like folders.

pattern.description: Token pattern: %USERPROFILE%, %APPDATA%, %LOCALAPPDATA%, %LOCALLOW%, %DOCUMENTS%, %SAVEDGAMES%, %PUBLIC%, %PUBLICDOCS%, %PROGRAMDATA%, %STEAMUSERDATA%, %GAMEDIR%. Wildcards * and ? are allowed.

mode.description: How the path is restored: token = expand in the new profile; gamedir = next to the discovered game install; absolute = original path; auto = best effort.

sample.description: The absolute path this pattern was created from (informational).
